extraction_notes: Table S1 performance entries were extracted; particle size/dispersion were treated as characterization and not recorded except insofar as needed for TOF basis. Table S2 activation energies and Table S3 anion/lattice-parameter data are out of scope. SI Figures S3–S5 contain dense Arrhenius/reaction-order log plots or isotopic-exchange data; individual NH3-synthesis points were not extracted because exact temperatures/feed compositions are not printed in the SI and values would require uncertain reading from transformed axes. SI Figure S7 stability points were readable and extracted approximately.
